record.claim: At commit 876b3422 no storage cleanup routine is triggered automatically. tools/work_gc.py is called only by hand and by the report-only tools/storage_report.sh; work/.gc/log.jsonl records prunes of 1,116 MiB on 2026-11-13 and 1,054 MiB on 2026-11-19 and none later. work_gc has no scratch class for an official server install, and its original-copy class compares only against icarus-orig/, icarus-client-orig/ and reference-data/; no document sets a retention count for superseded server builds. tools/cargo_guard.py (DISK_FLOOR 30 GiB, RESERVE 8 GiB, TARGET_BUDGET 16 GiB) caps only its own target, reports other worktree targets without summing them, refuses a different CARGO_TARGET_DIR and has no warning band above floor plus reserve. The guard and the storage report enumerate only git worktree list entries, so a checkout whose admin directory is gone is invisible to both. The babysit-pr and file-pr skills contain no post-merge worktree cleanup step. No host timer measures disk.
record.limits: Read from code and configuration by one session; harness-side cleanup (T3 settings) was read from settings, not from its code.
